### rustfs/rustfs (rustfs)

### [`v1.0.4`](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/releases/tag/1.0.4): RustFS 1.0.4

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/compare/1.0.3...1.0.4)

This patch updates certificate verification and bundled trust roots, removes the distrusted emSign ECC Root CA - G3 from container trust stores, and retains the dependency refresh.

#### What's Changed

- chore(deps): refresh dependencies and pin Pulsar 6.9.0 by [@​houseme](https://redirect.github.com/houseme) in [#​8923](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/8923)
- fix(test): backport scanner wait correction for 1.0.4 by [@​overtrue](https://redirect.github.com/overtrue) in [#​8930](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/8930)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/compare/1.0.3...1.0.4>

### [`v1.0.3`](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/releases/tag/1.0.3): RustFS 1.0.3

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/compare/1.0.2...1.0.3)

#### What's Changed

RustFS 1.0.3 keeps the 1.0.2 server code and updates the embedded Console to [v0.1.37](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/console/releases/tag/v0.1.37).

- Hide the duplicate bucket heading at the bucket root, where names could appear truncated despite the full name being visible in the top navigation.
- Add Vietnamese localization and improve deleted-object highlighting and filtering.
- Update workspace package versions to 1.0.3. No other server changes from main are included.

The release candidate passed Console upload, download, deletion, bucket and folder navigation checks, plus rc 0.1.36 compatibility checks.

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/compare/1.0.2...1.0.3>
